zh: 拿起两个杯子，把<source_cup>里的<beans>全倒进<target_cup>，再把杯子放回桌上
将<source_cup>里的<beans>一颗不剩地倒入<target_cup>
用<source_cup>把<beans>都倒给<target_cup>，倒完把两个杯子放好
请把<source_cup>里装的<beans>都倒到<target_cup>中，然后放下两个杯子
en: Pick up both cups, pour every one of the <beans> from <source_cup> into <target_cup>, then put the cups back.
Transfer all of the <beans> from <source_cup> to <target_cup>.
Pour the <beans> out of <source_cup> into <target_cup>, all of them.
Use <source_cup> to pour all its <beans> into <target_cup> and set both cups down.
Move all the <beans> in <source_cup> over to <target_cup>.
Please pour the <beans> held in <source_cup> into <target_cup> completely, then put both cups down.

zh: 把<beans>挪个地方：从<source_cup>挪到<target_cup>，一颗也别撒
en: <target_cup> needs the <beans>; give it everything in <source_cup>.
Empty <source_cup>: every one of the <beans> belongs in <target_cup>.
Relocate the <beans> from <source_cup> to <target_cup> without spilling any.
Make <target_cup> hold all the <beans> that are now in <source_cup>.
